name: Khelden Bremen
summary: On the upper floor of Northshire Abbey, Khelden Bremen teaches human mages their first spells. He prepares novices to serve Stormwind through the arcane arts.

sections.title: Tutor of the Arcane
sections.body: Khelden Bremen teaches new human mages in a study on the upper floor of Northshire Abbey. While clergy and defenders pursue their work below, he shows novices how to focus and shape magical energy safely. His lessons prepare them for the road through Elwynn Forest and for further study in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

faq.answer: Khelden Bremen trains new mages at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. He teaches their first spells and the foundations of arcane study.

faq.q: Where can I find Khelden Bremen?
faq.answer: Khelden Bremen is on the second floor of Northshire Abbey. Enter the abbey and take the staircase in the second room on the left.

faq.q: What role does he play for new adventurers?
faq.answer: Human mages arriving in Northshire are directed to Khelden Bremen, often with a Glyphic Letter of introduction. He teaches their first spells and helps them control their magical aptitude.

angles.text: As a human mage, Khelden Bremen offers your first formal arcane instruction before you continue your studies in the towers of Stormwind City.
